data.summary_en: REPRO, pure black-box evolutionary adversarial prompt optimizer, uses single-GPU compressed open-weight 7B reflection model to drive search, semantic crossover, and Thompson Sampling strategy selection. Across 36 target models in 11 families (AdvBench/JailbreakBench/HarmBench), it achieves single-round attack success for each evaluated target; target-query median/behavior: 24.
